front:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Game-ready modular Chinese xianxia portrait sprite. Input 1 is an existing isolated hair sprite, the exact 1024x1536 placement template and edit target; input 2 is only the original composed portrait for style and scale reference.
Keep the EXACT input 1 canvas dimensions and absolute position. Output a single isolated hair sprite with real transparent alpha, no backdrop at all. No soft shadow, glow, aura, grey matte, mist or paper outside actual strands. Pixels between and around strands are completely transparent; fine antialiasing only along actual strand edges.
Style is delicate gongbi ink linework with restrained ink washes, natural matte very deep charcoal hair. Main masses near RGB35–50, restrained warm-grey strands RGB65–90. NOT grey hair, not silver highlights, not brown hair, not glossy plastic, not photorealistic. Maintain authentic ancient Chinese front-facing hairstyle. Refine into coherent main locks with finer subordinate strands and very few flyaways; avoid dense white striations, curls, loops and wispy fuzz. Match the original refined painted portrait. No skin, ears, face, eyebrows, body, clothes, ornaments, text, labels or watermarks.
FRONT HAIR ONLY. Keep original middle part, front scalp cap, face-framing side locks and two full chest-front locks. Simplify the inflated rounded cap to fit the skull with modest hair thickness, but keep natural rich volume rather than a hard thin helmet. Natural mostly straight falling locks with soft subtle curvature, not broad wavy loops and not two tiny strings.
Registration is literal on the full original canvas: crown apex around (517,140), center hairline around (517,277), left/right hairline around (447,310)/(590,310). Leave face opening clear. Do not cover the central eyebrow/eye region x430..605 y340..405. Temple hair near x400/634 y380, complete chest locks end around y980. Keep original central opening shape and dimensions so existing face and eyes fit. Do not move the hair toward the middle of the canvas. The long locks belong to this front layer and connect continuously from roots to tips. Back-of-neck and shoulder-back hair must be absent.
